description: This source file contains in-memory implementations of repositories for Users, Orders, and TrackingEvents, all using thread-safe collections. It defines classes that implement respective repository interfaces, providing methods for adding, retrieving, and updating data within an in-memory context, for a delivery management system.

classes.name: InMemoryUserRepository
classes.description: In-memory implementation of IUserRepository for managing User entities, supporting add and retrieval operations by email or ID.

classes.name: InMemoryOrderRepository
classes.description: In-memory implementation of IOrderRepository for managing Order entities, supporting add, retrieval by ID, retrieval by user, and update operations.

classes.name: InMemoryTrackingRepository
classes.description: In-memory implementation of ITrackingRepository for managing TrackingEvent entities, supporting adding events and retrieval by order ID.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new User, Order, or TrackingEvent to the respective in-memory store.

methods.name: GetByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves a User by email address, case-insensitive.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves an entity (User or Order) by its unique identifier.

methods.name: GetByUser
methods.description: Retrieves all Orders associated with a given user ID.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates an existing Order with new data.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a TrackingEvent to the in-memory event store.

methods.name: GetByOrderId
methods.description: Retrieves all TrackingEvents associated with a specific order ID, ordered by timestamp.
